Thanks again for the time earlier. As discussed, the goal for this kickoff is to align on the implementation runway for: streaming outputs (real-time token streaming), function/tool-calling for live data lookups, and structured JSON outputs (schema validation).

Attached: medix_mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (draft), medix_streaming_sample_schema.json (example payload)

Proposed slots: Thu 6/17 11:00–11:45 PT or Fri 6/18 09:00–09:45 PT. Which works for you?

Cheers,
Rishi

Samir — great, thanks. Fri 9:00 PT is confirmed. Looping Marissa (CS lead) and Ben (Solutions) to run the implementation plan and technical checklist.

Marissa / Ben — summary of what Medix wants: real-time streaming for clinician-facing summaries, function/tool-calls to fetch patient metadata from Medix systems, and structured JSON outputs validated by schema for downstream analytics. They plan to run in our US clouds and will need SOC2 artifacts and a network onboarding checklist from IT.

Immediate asks for the kickoff:
- SE deep-dive item: sample payloads and error modes for streaming (see medix_streaming_sample_schema.json attached)
- Security: list of artifacts (SOC2 scope, retention, audit logs) — Samir, Elaine: please confirm the names of your security contacts
- Integration: decide on auth approach for tool-calls (service account preferred by Redwood; we can support delegated flows)

I'll prepare a short agenda and a one-pager mapping milestones to owners (draft MAP attached).

Thanks,
Rishi

Subject: Medix kickoff — Mutual Action Plan & agenda

Hi Samir / Elaine — pleasure to meet you both (virtually).

Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan with clear milestones, owners, and dates. Key checkpoints we recommend for a 6‑week pilot:
- Week 0: Kickoff + security intake (SOC2 scoping, network checklist)
- Week 1–2: SE schema validation + test harness for streaming tool (dev sandbox)
- Week 3–4: Integration window for tool-calls and auth hardening
- Week 5: End-to-end pilot run + quality checks (structured outputs pass validation)
- Week 6: Pilot retro + next steps for production roll-out

Agenda for Fri 6/18 09:00 PT (30–45m):
1) Intros & roles (5m)
2) High-level architecture & data flow (10m)
3) Schema & streaming examples (10m)
4) Security/compliance questions (5m)
5) Action items and owners (5–10m)

Action items for Medix before the meeting:
- Share security contact and any constraints on service accounts (Elaine / IT)
- Provide a representative test dataset (anonymized) or synthetic equivalent

Links: Shared Drive (agenda + MAP) — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMEDIX_ONBOARD

See attached: medix_mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx, redwood_kickoff_agenda.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference

Security artifacts: we do not publish full SOC2 reports to external recipients before an NDA in some cases; however, we can provide a SOC2 summary pack and our PenTest summary. Marissa / Ben will bring the summary artifacts to the call and follow up with the redacted attestations via secure link post-NDA.

Streaming transport: Redwood supports websocket-based streaming and chunked HTTP streaming; for the pilot we typically recommend websocket for the lowest end-to-end latency. We'll include network ports and an example client snippet in the kickoff packet.

Confirmed call: Fri 2028-06-18 09:00 PT (calendar invite sent). Owners for the MAP are in the attached file.

- Marissa: finalize MAP and add go/no-go criteria
- Ben: prepare schema walkthrough + sample tooling harness
